entities.summary: The Xeración Galaxia were a group of Galician language writers centred on the Editorial Galaxia which was established to publish and translate modern texts that would develop Galician national literature. The name echoes that of the 1920s intellectual group Xeración Nós who promoted Galician culture in the 1920s.
